scope: Independent read-only review of two production paths, three associated test paths and nine published original fixture paths; source inspection only, no test imports/execution, OCR replay, new device capture, CI call for the historical diagnostic, source edit or Git mutation.

source_binding.published_checkpoint_source: Parent notification; this review did not independently fetch that commit.

observations: The actual list clip is derived from the current PNG's unique workshop outline, scrollbar track and thumb; exact current Karts/workshop/start captions and landscape/full-surface evidence remain required. The old tab/footer rectangle no longer defines the gesture area.

Both production files are integrated against the exact existing 0b7/1158 bytes. The whole stage_garage_word_observations function is byte-identical. Its contiguous known-name, original-TSV, confidence, bounds and ambiguity checks are retained and can guide only scrolling.

Scroll authorization requires two observations with different frame names, equal dimensions, stable clip/gesture/track/thumb and direction, stable original word evidence where used, unchanged current and previous PNG hashes, no more than five gestures, positive remaining time immediately before ADB and a strict post-input deadline check.

The new selection caller gathers all caption regions, requires a complete exact requested name strictly inside the actual clip, rejects distinct repeated target regions, resets stability after missing targets or viewport movement, uses the unchanged target_observation helper and verifies the current PNG again immediately before input.
A missing or clipped card caption may support only an observed bounded scroll. The source does not infer a target tap from scrollbar position, fleet order, partial names or word-fallback evidence.

The native 14-name order and three relevant source files are byte-bound to the preserved bebf and current 2281 copies; the two personally viewed original images corroborate different horizontal insets, a clipped caption, the narrow scrollbar and the fixed workshop area.

Unchanged main-tour functions still require a fresh real race selection/save, RUNDE/GAS, physical movement, pause/continue and subsequent save identity. _continue_actual_race remains byte-identical with standalone_caption=True.

All 24 new test methods were read, including current/previous image substitution, two scrollbars, JPEG rejection, missing anchors, changing viewport, deadlines, incomplete or duplicated names, and observation sequencing. Their empty TSV headers are explicitly synthetic for pixel-only cases; the existing 14-case Boru suite retains real TSV fixture bytes.

visual_originals_seen.finding: Requested caption is clipped at the list's upper boundary; no complete target should be inferred.
Different left inset and a complete Comet card above the fixed workshop; no hard-coded touch position used by the production patch.

limitations: No new Android gesture or current-candidate acceptance was performed by this reviewer.
The older successful diagnostic cited by the producer belongs to another host/native pair and does not establish success for 0b7, 1158 or 9f2f.
Fixture bytes were checked against the preserved published producer copies and source.json; this reviewer did not download the historical artifact ZIPs.
Pixel color/geometry recognition remains intentionally source-specific and fail-closed if the real surface changes.

The first broad diff read was tool-output-truncated and was rejected by an independent hash check. The two complete production diffs and relevant complete test/dependency texts were subsequently read separately with hash validation; no conclusion relies on the truncated text.
The current 0b7 C4 run is a separate ongoing build and is not evidence that these new source bytes have run.
